title: Why Bikers Flash Their Lights Before a Turn
hook: Ever wonder why bikers flash their lights just before turning?

script.narration: Ever wonder why bikers flash their lights just before turning?
script.visual_search: motorcyclist flashing headlights on city street

script.narration: It’s not a stunt – it’s a safety signal. A quick flash warns drivers behind that the rider is about to change lanes or turn, giving them extra reaction time. Studies show flashing reduces rear‑end collisions by up to 30%. So the next time you see a bike flash, give them space and expect a move. It’s a simple, universal cue that keeps everyone safer on the road.
